lead.headline: Prediction markets cross the regulatory Rubicon as Robinhood's event contracts outearn crypto trading
lead.tldr: Prediction markets have flipped from regulatory pariah to the fastest-growing revenue line in retail finance, forcing a repricing of who can capture value in on-chain derivatives and forcing regulators to draft rules in real time.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, today the most durable edge in crypto infrastructure is the one that lets regulated incumbents sell unregulated-adjacent products without touching the legal risk.

top_signals.title: Binance launches regulated gold, silver options through ADGM exchange12m
top_signals.summary: Binance has launched regulated gold and silver options trading through its exchange in the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM). This move integrates traditional precious metals with digital trading infrastructure under a regulated framework.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Binance's ADGM gold and silver options show that regulated wrappers for commodity exposure are becoming the preferred path for exchanges to serve institutional capital that cannot hold unregulated crypto directly.

top_signals.title: BNY to bring transfer agency records onchain in blockchain push11m, BNY to bring transfer agency records onchain in blockchain pushBNY is launching a blockchain-based transfer agency platform as the bank expands its digital asset infrastructure and moves core financial records onchain.
top_signals.summary: BNY is launching a blockchain-based transfer agency platform to move core financial records onchain. This initiative is part of the bank's broader strategy to expand its digital asset infrastructure.
top_signals.why_it_matters: BNY moving transfer agency records on-chain is a structural signal that the plumbing of traditional finance is being rebuilt on shared ledgers, which compresses reconciliation costs and resets competitive moats for fund administrators.

top_signals.title: Binance.US to apply for CFTC license in August for prediction market platform
top_signals.summary: Binance.US plans to apply for a designated contract market license from the CFTC in August. This move is intended to support the launch of a prediction market platform.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Binance.US filing for a CFTC license in August reveals that prediction markets are now treated as a regulated derivatives product worth fighting for, not a regulatory grey zone to avoid.

top_signals.title: Robinhood’s prediction markets top crypto and equities revenue in Q2
top_signals.summary: Robinhood's prediction markets outperformed its cryptocurrency and equities revenue in Q2. The platform generated $156 million from event contracts, surpassing the $100 million earned from crypto trading.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Robinhood's $156 million in prediction market revenue against $100 million from crypto trading means event contracts have become the highest-yielding product in retail finance, and every platform's unit economics just got reunderwritten.

top_signals.title: US Prosecutors Propose Changes to CLARITY as Voting Window Narrows: Report
top_signals.summary: US prosecutors are proposing amendments to the Blockchain Regulatory Certainty Act within a larger crypto bill. The proposed changes specifically aim to include guidelines regarding the legal status and responsibilities of blockchain developers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Prosecutors amending CLARITY to target developer liability shows US lawmakers are moving from vague threats to specific legal hooks, which raises the cost of building permissionless infrastructure and favors compliant intermediaries.

on_the_radar.title: Tether’s GENIUS-compliant USAT stablecoin launches on Celo, marking first expansion beyond Ethereum
on_the_radar.summary: Tether has launched its GENIUS-compliant USAT stablecoin on the Celo network, marking its first expansion outside of Ethereum. The integration allows USAT to be used for gas payments on Celo, simplifying the user experience.

on_the_radar.title: Safe smart accounts process nearly 130 million transactions in record quarter
on_the_radar.summary: Safe reported record growth in Q2 2026, with its smart accounts processing nearly 130 million transactions. The provider has seen its total number of created accounts grow to over 63 million.

on_the_radar.title: Emirates Lets UAE Residents Pay for Flights Through Crypto.com
on_the_radar.summary: Emirates Airlines has integrated Crypto.com Pay, enabling eligible UAE residents to book flights using cryptocurrency. The system allows users to pay with digital assets while the airline receives settlement in UAE dirhams.

on_the_radar.title: MoonPay Unveils PayBox AI Vault for ChatGPT and Claude Users
on_the_radar.summary: MoonPay has introduced PayBox, an AI payment vault designed for users of ChatGPT and Claude. The tool allows AI agents to facilitate crypto purchases, token swaps, and blockchain transactions while ensuring users maintain custody of their assets.

on_the_radar.title: Crypto Exchanges Push into Stocks and Commodities: CoinGecko Report
on_the_radar.summary: A report by CoinGecko highlights the growth of tokenized traditional assets, which have reached a total value of $6.6 billion. This trend is driven by crypto exchanges diversifying their offerings to include stocks and commodities to remain competitive.

on_the_radar.title: CoinCash Gets MiCA License as Hungary Repeals Crypto Rules
on_the_radar.summary: CoinCash has become the first Hungarian platform to receive authorization under the EU's MiCA framework. Simultaneously, Hungary has repealed its previous crypto validator requirements to align with these new regulations.

on_the_radar.title: Russia charges Telegram founder Pavel Durov with aiding terrorism, issues arrest warrant: report
on_the_radar.summary: Russian security forces have charged Telegram founder Pavel Durov with aiding terrorism. An international arrest warrant has been issued for his capture.

on_the_radar.title: Cross-Border Payments Top Stablecoin Use Case in UK Policy Sprint
on_the_radar.summary: The UK's Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) reports that industry participants view cross-border payments as the most viable near-term use case for stablecoins. While international transfers show promise, the adoption of stablecoins for domestic retail payments is expected to be slower.

worth_a_read.title: Pliant hits $100m ARR following US expansion
worth_a_read.note: Pliant's $100 million ARR milestone after US expansion offers a benchmark for European fintechs crossing the Atlantic and the revenue velocity required to justify the burn.

worth_a_read.title: Datacenter Expansion and Strategy with Simrit Dhinsa
worth_a_read.note: Simrit Dhinsa's datacenter strategy discussion maps how compute infrastructure is being positioned for the AI-crypto convergence, where power access matters more than code.

worth_a_read.title: No Headstands Required: Applying Securities Laws to Vaults and Onchain Lending
worth_a_read.note: Galaxy's securities law framework for on-chain vaults and lending directly addresses the compliance architecture that BNY and others are now building around.

linkedin_post:
Robinhood made $156 million on prediction markets last quarter. $100 million from crypto. That gap will widen.

We've watched event contracts migrate from Polymarket's regulatory exile to CFTC-licensed products in under two years. The velocity matters. Binance.US is now filing for that same license in August. The product is being laundered through compliance infrastructure, and the platforms that own the compliance layer capture the spread.

This is not a crypto story. It is a derivatives story wearing crypto's clothes. The value shift is from token trading to regulated contract infrastructure. BNY putting transfer agency records on-chain, Binance wrapping gold options through ADGM—same pattern. Incumbents and near-incumbents building rails that let them sell the excitement without holding the legal heat.

What kills this thesis: CFTC delays or denies the Binance.US application, proving the bottleneck is political, not technical. What confirms it: a second major retail broker launches prediction markets by year-end, pricing the product as core, not experimental.

We are underwriting the infrastructure layer on the assumption that regulated access to speculative products outperforms unregulated access to speculative products. That has held for two decades. No reason it stops now.

The question is whether any crypto-native builder can still own the customer, or whether the customer belongs to whoever already has the brokerage account.
